result.question: How much did Nvidia spend on research and development in its latest fiscal year (FY2026)?
result.answer: NVIDIA spent $18,497,000,000 (approximately $18.5 billion) on research and development in fiscal year 2026, which ended January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2026-01-25]. This figure is also reflected in the company's Consolidated Statements of Income, where research and development represented 8.6% of revenue for the fiscal year ended January 25, 2026 [0001045810-26-000021:item-7-p007].
